page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A2.Flex.8-64 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the arm64 architecture. The server is configured with 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs powered by an Ampere AmpereOne processor running at a base clock frequency of 3.0 GHz. Because it operates with one thread per physical core, execution pipelines avoid resource contention associated with simultaneous multithreading.

System memory totals 64.0 GB, providing an exact 1:4 core-to-memory distribution of 4.0 GB per core. The instance includes no integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for operating systems and user storage. In addition, it does not include GPU accelerators. Network connectivity provisions include one complimentary public IPv4 address.

The hardware configuration provides high resource efficiency for workloads optimized for 64-bit ARM ecosystems. Tradeoffs include the lack of local NVMe storage and absence of x86-specific hardware extensions. VM.Standard.A2.Flex.8-64 is suited for microservices architectures, web applications, continuous integration pipelines, and standard enterprise workloads.
